cpu: AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 470 w/ Radeon 890M
measurement: Sequential fresh Release children after builds/tests stop. Every sample parses/typechecks real .pgs and runs Stage WITH Recorder definition identity, semantic cache off. Build-only never queries/exports/restores; query children additionally execute native aa source query with front end and HIR retained. For query children /proc/self/clear_refs=5 resets the RSS high-water mark after capturing build VmHWM. Query VmHWM is sampled immediately after the query, including the retained front end/HIR baseline (reported separately), not a fresh query-only reader. Whole-child peak is max(pre-reset build VmHWM, exit wait4 RSS), including startup/front end/Stage/enumeration/destruction and potentially a fork/pre-exec parent-RSS floor on Linux; use build VmHWM for compilation comparisons. Read/write counters include this measurement IO. Census children are separate, instrument end-of-recording maps and before/after Analyzer cleanup, then traverse reachable HIR. Capacities include vectors, map value objects/buckets and owned heap strings/constants; exclude map links, shared_ptr control blocks, allocator overhead and census indexes. Snapshot/sampled categories do not sum to a complete peak RSS. Kernel /proc/self/io counters are sampled after file enumeration, before output/destructors, including loader/source and FileStore verification read/write traffic; counters' own reads add small overhead. read_bytes/write_bytes are kernel storage accounting with warm OS caches, NOT physical-device traffic; directory/unlink metadata operations and later cleanup are outside syscall-byte counters. File enumeration includes the session lock marker; CAS bytes/files are separate. No page-cache flushing, core pinning or fixed frequency. Relative to C4b3a, this corpus uses definition identity and additional workloads, so do not attribute cross-report differences to spill or cleanup.
